reviews.title: Waste of Money!
reviews.text: This app is a waste of money.  First, it is not a “chair” program as advertised.  Second, the video exercises don’t line up with the video and there are no directions for each move.  Find something better - don’t spend your money here!

reviews.title: I love this app
reviews.text:
Because of my job, I don't have much time to go to the gym. This app offers easy exercises for any level. You don't have to invest a lot of time; if you're consistent, you'll see the difference in your body. I've tried other apps, but none are as comprehensive and easy to use as this one.

Por mi trabajo, no tengo mucho tiempo para ir al gimnasio. Esta app ofrece ejercicios fáciles para cualquier nivel. No tienes que invertir mucho tiempo y, si eres constante, notarás la diferencia en tu cuerpo. He probado otras apps, y ninguna es tan completa y fácil de usar como este.
